contract: Road user x is inside region r on its current entry and came in through region c: x's footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and at every observation since the observation at which this overlap began (the footprint overlapping r there and not at the observation before), and at that beginning x's footprint also overlapped c. The state is recognized at each observation of the current overlap and ends at the first observation at which x's footprint does not overlap r. Unknown where the beginning of the current overlap is not observed: an overlap already under way at x's first observation, or an overlap of r unobserved at every observation back to x's first one, so that the search for the beginning reaches x's first observation without finding it; or an unobserved overlap of r or c at an observation that decides it. Not denoted: that c is an approach to r (the caller states the entry topology), the direction x moved, or where x was before the beginning.

act.onset: the observation at which this overlap began (the footprint overlapping r there and not at the observation before)
act.recognition: The state is recognized at each observation of the current overlap
act.extent: x's footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and at every observation since the observation at which this overlap began
act.history: where x was before the beginning

elements.span: x's footprint overlaps r (rel.occupies) at the observation and at every observation since the observation at which this overlap began
elements.justification: rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region'; held at every observation since its last rise (past mirror of until), the rise being the overlap true there and not at the observation before.

elements.span: at that beginning x's footprint also overlapped c
elements.justification: rel.occupies: 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region', read for x and c at the observation at which the overlap of r rose.

elements.span: an overlap of r unobserved at every observation back to x's first one, so that the search for the beginning reaches x's first observation without finding it
elements.justification: rel.occupies is three-valued ('not observed on this source'); where it is unobserved back to x's first observation the beginning of the overlap is not observed and the search into the past reaches the start of x's history, so the state is unknown, never true or false.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: x overlaps c and not r at t0, overlaps c and r at t1, overlaps r only at t2; judged at t2.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: x overlaps region c2 and not r at t0, overlaps c2 and r at t1 without overlapping c, overlaps r at t2; judged at t2.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The scenes of holds with rel.occupies masked by the manifest: x's overlap of r and of c is unobserved at every observation, so the beginning of the current overlap is not observed and the search for it reaches x's first observation (t0) without finding it; judged at t2.
